It signifies a woman who is dedicated to her faith and strives to live her life in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name reflects the important role of obedience and devotion to Allah, and is a reminder of the spiritual journey that each Muslim must undertake in their lifetime. The name "Kardawiyah" inspires a woman to be a role model of faith and commitment, not only for her loved ones, but for the wider Muslim community.
